entries.reason: The recipe build models the docs body by hand; the capture reads the host page's body rule, under its own name.
The page's body rule and Fuse's base layer on it, as the browser applies them.
Tailwind's preflight and Fuse's base layer on `<html>`, as the browser applies them.
Tailwind's preflight, which the capture page loads as the docs host does; its resets drop or read as the zero they set.
Fuse's base layer, which the recipe build modelled only for the border color: box sizing, zero border, margin and padding.

match.detail: no rule of the class wins a declaration on an element of any captured cell

entries.reason: Each class that styles nothing in any cell, or whose rules matched and lost, found by the browser instead of listed by hand.

CSS clips nothing here (`overflow` is `visible` initially, CSS Overflow 3 §3) and the set's root casts no shadow in any cell, so the capture-backed root leaves its layers unclipped, and a ring at its edge shows as in the browser. A root that casts a shadow still clips, since Figma draws a spread only from a clipping frame (PR2).

match.detail: an element of the component's markup around the root, which the kit draws no layer for

entries.reason: The capture cascades every declaration the component's elements around the root win, as the recipe cascade cascades an ancestor its definition names; what no layer reads drops with the element's reason.

match.detail: the root's percentage height resolves against the content height this element sets around it

entries.reason: The stepper's `h-full` takes the content height its steppers' row and the field box around it set, `calc(var(--control-h-md) - 2px)`, which binds `field-box-content-h` as the recipe definition's hand-written `previewHeight` did; the capture names the declarations it reads.

match.detail: the root sets its own, so it does not inherit this

entries.reason: The field box's custom properties, which the capture now cascades with the elements around the stepper; the stepper sets its own, so it inherits none of them.
Base UI writes `user-select: none` on the stepper's `style`, which the recipe build never saw; a static frame has no selection.
